The browser extension with the new video button reaches Firefox Add-ons, and the desktop installer follows PommelPorter 1.1.5. Everything else is the same as in [v2.7.4](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/releases/tag/v2.7.4).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The browser extension reaches Firefox Add-ons again.** Firefox Add-ons turned 2.7.4 away because its notes for the reviewers were one character over the limit, so Firefox stayed on 2.7.3 without the video button. The notes are shorter, and a release that would go over the limit stops before the upload and says why.
- **Uninstalling the desktop app on Windows leaves nothing behind,** and the installer window shows KnightLoader's icon on Linux. The installer follows [PommelPorter 1.1.5](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/pommelporter/releases/tag/v1.1.5).
